description: Keep formal conclusions within proved scope.

lesson.applicability: Summarizing proved, disproved or open research claims across formal modules, quantitative certificates and generated worker briefs.
lesson.cause: The quantitative margin, qualitative property, proof coverage and status of the complementary interval were conflated.
lesson.correction: Give each claim its actual evidence grade and assumptions. Separate qualitative positivity, quantitative margins and endpoint status; retain every consequence already justified by the stated argument, while keeping finite checks, formal declarations and open bridges distinct. Inspect the deciding predicate: written-argument and table-presence checks do not establish semantic correctness or discharge imported premises.
lesson.counterexample: R4-OBJ-06 found theta^2*(1/2-c*theta)>0 beyond theta_* through the open endpoint 2*theta_*; only the stronger margin stopped at theta_*. R5 stage-5 PASS entries cite a written proof with imported KP criterion and audit_table_present, without a semantic verifier.
lesson.evidence_excerpt: W/docs/meron_euclidean_thermodynamic_limit.md TL-1, TL-2 (written proof; imported KP criterion)
lesson.exceptions: A zero or negative lower bound does not show the actual quantity is zero or negative. An explicit conditional theorem remains useful; finite arithmetic does not certify its analytic premises. A weaker consequence may already follow without a new experiment.
lesson.failed_claim: The range of a quantitative certificate exhausts every proved qualitative consequence and determines what fails outside it.
lesson.verification: Read all 15 R3-R5 stages 1-5 (158537 bytes) and the earlier reviewed critics/repairs/raw outputs. R5 reports bond and wire repairs; R6 reports source repair but leaves assembled-K binding open. Stage-5 written/presence PASS labels do not verify analytic premises. The prior Fraction check is conditional arithmetic only. No fresh Meron, Lean or provider execution.

predicate: Each claim has a supported evidence grade, premises and parameter/end-point scope, with quantitative and qualitative conclusions separated.
response: Correct overclaims and unsupported open labels; retain justified consequences and carry only unresolved obligations forward.
trigger: Before summarizing proved, disproved or open research claims
